audience: Individuals running personal life-admin, home ops, and fitness from one daily brief

bots.why: Weekday brief of open items with one FIRST marker; invented nothing, pads nothing.
Weekly home-ops review; carries the household list between runs.
Weekly coaching check-in; the largest built personal category allots one bot per lane, not one bot for everything.
Keep the fleet small: every proposed Bot defaults to zero until a manual workflow has already worked.
Turns the week's piled errands into one ordered trip.
Shared grocery and errand list for two humans; who added each item, what is still open, no send.
Week-1 Bot: diffs installed plugin gitRefs and quotes every move. Installed is not working.

human_steps: Approve or edit every draft before it sends; no bot in this pack sends anything on its own.
Install and sign in to Gmail, Calendar, and Drive connectors by hand; paste each charter and type each routine prompt in chat.
Say when a brief item is done; bot guesses are never completions.
Confirm disk-cleanup deletions from the disksaver-audit report before anything is removed.
name: Personal Productivity
policies: DRAFT-NEVER-SEND: every outbound is a draft until the human says send on that exact message.
NO-AUTO-DELETE: triage archives nothing without an explicit yes; cleanup deletions need per-item confirmation.
MEMORY-EXPLICIT: an item stays open until the operator says it is done.

routines.name: weekday-morning-brief
routines.prompt_hint: Post the brief: date, open items with FIRST marked, overnight adds; one line and stop if nothing is open.

routines.name: weekly-home-ops-review
routines.prompt_hint: Post the home-ops list: what is open, what stalled, the one thing to move this week.

routines.name: weekly-fitness-checkin
routines.prompt_hint: Post the training check-in: last week actuals vs plan, this week plan, one form cue.

tagline: One brief each morning; home, health, and inbox each get a lane.
